purpose: One fixed adaptive recovery on immutable MNIST releases. The MNIST and SVHN public classifiers are identical, so preserving SVHN by a universal head nullspace would prohibit target score updates. Add an empirical input nullspace estimated from 256 public SVHN training images; fit target scores once on the exact prior 256 MNIST calibration images. Compare direct, the frozen prior head-only attack, and input-constrained recovery on matched original/erased releases.
limits: This is an attack diagnostic, not a new defense, full SLOA, or an all-seven-partner guarantee. SVHN scores are constrained on calibration inputs only; test predictions must be measured. Defender is unchanged and uses no partner. Attacker sees public partner inputs and student features, no SVHN true labels or teacher features. No rank, coefficient, sample or ridge search. Previously inspected tests are not a fresh holdout.
